gaps.concept: Typed scalar and array engine attributes
gaps.reason: The backend accepts native JSON values; keyvalue represents object roots. Other root shapes need the declared projection contract in Decision 9.
Parser, key block size and engine attributes remain preserved in native owning-table DDL. Structured default-value projection for these fields is not yet available.

MySQL has native rename and visibility operations, but no ALTER INDEX key-part definition. Existing table controlled-change/DDN workflows own native DROP/ADD definition changes; this form does not silently recreate an index.

gaps.concept: Primary engine attributes outside beta profile
gaps.reason: Core SQL hooks require HTON_SUPPORTS_ENGINE_ATTRIBUTE. No implementation in the audited MySQL9.7 Community engine sources advertises it; release InnoDB/MyISAM/MEMORY reject index use with native error3981. Debug simulation is not product support. A separately available implementation and native qualification are required before surfacing this field. Secondary-engine attribute metadata is separate.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The native edit action is rename; this field binds to its existing new_name draft property.

columns.label: Expression
columns.help: Supply a column or an expression per row. Native grammar and storage-engine restrictions are checked by MySQL.

fields.label: Key block size
fields.help: Unsigned decimal text preserves the native integer range. MySQL owns storage-engine restrictions and warnings.

notes: Draft; every create binding reaches mysql_indexes.compile_create, retaining legacy string columns while adding typed key parts. Name editing binds the existing rename action. Visibility is a separate typed operation. Shared SQL tab and render/round-trip acceptance belong to the front-end stream; no unified UI completion is claimed.
